basic_info.description: Great Value and price for the square footage! This is a 2-3 bedroom 1 bath w/a 1+bed/2 bath ADU done w/PERMITS and VACANT. Period details & modern updates, newer kitchen w/large breakfast bar as well as formal dining & large window overlooking the backyard. The bathroom has been completely remodeled w/marble tiles & modern features. You are welcomed into a formal entry w/high ceilings & traditional living room w/fireplace & custom built seating at the bay windows. Three bedrooms, or 2 bedrooms & a dedicated office give this home flexibility for many. Downstairs is the completely remodeled ADU-(check out the kitchen!)perfect for additional office/entertaining space, out of town guests, or income potential. Additionally there is laundry located right off the kitchen as well as hook ups in the ADU, 1 car garage, a landscaped shared yard. Close proximity to three of the best neighborhoods & warmest weather in the city. With nearby shuttle stops & freeway access, potential condo conversion! What else could you ask for!
